candidates.summary: Delhi government has started a verification drive to identify and weed out ineligible beneficiaries of its old age pension scheme covering around 4.4 lakh senior citizens, officials said on Saturday. The verification process was to begin earlier, but it was halted as permission for Aadhaar authentication of the beneficiaries via a third party was not allowed. Now, the third party is carrying out door-to-door biometric beneficiary verification after receiving permission, said a senior functionary of the Delhi government. "The verification exercise will conclude in three months and we expect to create 20-25 per cent vacancies out of the total 4.4 lakh beneficiaries after weeding out the deceased and duplicate beneficiaries getting other government assistance besides the old age pension," he said. The government currently provides a monthly pension of Rs 2,000 to senior citizens aged between 60 and 69 years, while those aged 70 years and above are entitled to Rs 2,500 per month. Earl
candidates.title: Delhi govt begins identifying ineligible old-age pension beneficiaries

candidates.summary: Utssav CZ Gold Jewels Ltd has approved a 1:1 bonus share issue that would double its paid-up equity share capital to Rs 49.996 crore, subject to shareholders' approval and other regulatory clearances. The company's board approved the proposal on October 23 to issue one fully paid-up equity share of Rs 10 each for every existing share held by eligible shareholders, the jewellery manufacturer said in a statement. The proposed issue will comprise 2.5 crore bonus shares, increasing the total number of equity shares to 5 crore from 2.5 crore. The company's paid-up equity share capital will rise from Rs 24.998 crore to Rs 49.996 crore following the issue. The bonus shares will be issued from the company's securities premium, free reserves and retained earnings available as of March 31, 2026.
